iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 44. Ceasefire Day 3 BUT FRACTURING. Iran RECLOSED Strait of Hormuz Apr 8 in response to Israel's Lebanon strikes. Ceasefire terms disputed: Farsi text includes enrichment acceptance, English does not. Iran demanding $1/barrel tolls in crypto for Hormuz transit. Only 11 vessels transited Apr 8. IAEA still withdrawn. 440kg 60% HEU trapped at Isfahan. Bushehr struck 4 times - IAEA warns catastrophic radioactive risk. Trump pulled back threats for 2 weeks but enrichment remains unresolved. Ceasefire has ~11 days remaining. Hormuz reclosure is direct ceasefire violation. UN Guterres warns of 'wider war'. UNSC Resolution 2817 condemns Iran attacks on Gulf states. Technical: CRITICAL. Diplomatic: LOW (ceasefire framework collapsing). Probability UP to 42%.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 44. ⚠️ ESCALATING: Iran reclosed Strait of Hormuz Apr 8. Iranian military broadcasting warnings that unauthorized ships will be attacked. Only 11 vessels transited Apr 8. Demanding $1/barrel tolls in crypto. This is direct military action against global shipping. Ceasefire between US-Iran is conditional on Hormuz reopening - Iran just violated this. Trump's ceasefire under immediate threat. US offensive ops paused but may resume if Hormuz stays closed. Oil at highest since 2022. Diesel/jet fuel topping $200. Rhetoric: HIGH. Mobilization: HIGH (Hormuz military enforcement). Probability UP to 30%. Rising.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel–Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 44. ⚠️ MASSIVE ESCALATION: 182 killed in central Beirut Apr 8 alone, 890 wounded. Total in 5-week war: 1,739 killed, 5,873 wounded in Lebanon. 1.1 million displaced (20% of population). Israel destroyed Qasmieh bridge over Litani River. 50 jets, 160 bombs. Al Jazeera journalist killed in Gaza. Two Lebanese journalists killed. Netanyahu: ceasefire 'does not include Lebanon'. Trump: Lebanon is 'separate skirmish'. CRITICAL: Hezbollah RESUMED rocket attacks early Apr 9 on Kiryat Shmona and Manara - vowed to continue until aggression ceases. This means Hezbollah broke its pause. Israel's exploitation of the pause may now trigger full Hezbollah retaliation. Arab League condemned. Spain PM called for EU to suspend Israel association agreement. Rhetoric: CRITICAL. Mobilization: CRITICAL. Probability UP to 62%. RISING.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: NEW: NATO intercepted Iranian missiles over Turkish airspace during 2026 war. FM Fidan reiterated: Iran ambitions could push Turkey into nuclear arms race. NATO B61-12 production concluding 2026; Turkey excluded. Akkuyu NPP commissioning on track. Stable at 11%.

india.name: India–Pakistan
india.notes: US Intelligence: India-Pakistan 'remain a risk for nuclear conflict'. CSIS analysis of May 2025 crisis dynamics continues. Stable at 17%.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Structural risk unchanged. Strategic Rocket Forces at 90% modernization. NEW: Trump reportedly may discuss withdrawing from NATO during meeting with SG Rutte, citing lack of support during Iran war. If US exits NATO, European deterrence architecture collapses - would dramatically increase this zone. Lavrov warns Middle East conflict pushing states to acquire nukes. Stable at 60% for now. NATO withdrawal risk is a wildcard.

china.name: China
china.notes: ISW/AEI Apr 3 update: No significant PLA activity changes. Taiwan Strait stable. KMT Chairwoman Cheng Li-wun visiting China (Beijing proxy warfare). CNN investigation: China secretly expanding nuclear weapons infrastructure confirmed. Taiwan budget delay threatens $2.4B weapons. Technical: CRITICAL (long-term buildup). Stable at 11%.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: Day of escalation. CONFIRMED: SECOND missile launch in 2 days (Apr 8). Multiple SRBMs from Wonsan, flew ~240km each. VP FM Jang Kum-chol: South Korea 'most hostile enemy state', called them 'world-startling fools'. Kim observed cruise missile test from new destroyer. 10 missiles from MRLs. Constitutional nuclear status 'irreversible'. Submarine missile test anticipated. Kim demands US nuclear recognition as precondition. Rhetoric: CRITICAL. Technical: CRITICAL. Stable at 87%. No change today.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia–Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1140+. Russia preparing additional Oreshnik systems. Arms Control Association: Russia concocting fresh 'Ukrainian bomb' claims - potential pretext for escalation. New START expired Feb 2026 with no replacement. Full-blown arms race underway per Bulletin. Russia hybrid warfare escalating per GLOBSEC. Stable at 83%.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan–Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: DIPLOMATIC BREAKTHROUGH: China-hosted talks in Urumqi (Apr 1-7) concluded. Afghanistan and Pakistan agreed to 'avoid any escalation' and 'explore comprehensive solution'. Reuters: China says both sides committed to resolving differences and returning to normalcy. Kabul called talks 'useful'. China 'actively mediating' (FM Mao Ning). NEW: VP Vance delegation (incl. Kushner) heading to Islamabad this weekend - US diplomatic engagement increasing. TTP ceasefire for Eid holding. Diplomatic: HIGH. Probability DOWN to 10%. Falling.
